items.headline: Manchester United draw 2-2 at Everton with dramatic last-gasp equaliser
items.summary: Manchester United conceded a last-minute goal from Ainsley Maitland-Niles to draw 2-2 at Everton in the Premier League.

items.headline: Rasmus Hojlund joins Napoli permanently for £43 million
items.summary: Manchester United striker Rasmus Hojlund completed his permanent transfer to Napoli after a loan spell, following the Italian club's Champions League qualification.

items.headline: Casemiro departs Manchester United as contract expires
items.summary: Brazilian midfielder Casemiro left Manchester United at the end of the season following the expiration of his contract.
